### Triplet time-course analysis

```{r}
# Function to create Climate plot for one triplet type - FIXED
plot_triplet_timecourse_climate <- function(triplet_type, variable = "top") {
  df_triplet_climate <- data.frame()
  
  # Determine which groups have this triplet
  groups_with_triplet <- list()
  
  # Check Group 1
  if(triplet_type %in% df_triplets_g1$triplet) {
    groups_with_triplet[["Group 1"]] <- df_triplets_g1 %>%
      filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
      pull(session_end)
  }
  
  # Check Group 2
  if(triplet_type %in% df_triplets_g2$triplet) {
    groups_with_triplet[["Group 2"]] <- df_triplets_g2 %>%
      filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
      pull(session_end)
  }
  
  # Check Group 3 (same sequence as Group 2)
  if(triplet_type %in% df_triplets_g2$triplet) {
    groups_with_triplet[["Group 3"]] <- df_triplets_g2 %>%
      filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
      pull(session_end)
  }
  
  # Check Group 4
  if(triplet_type %in% df_triplets_g4$triplet) {
    groups_with_triplet[["Group 4"]] <- df_triplets_g4 %>%
      filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
      pull(session_end)
  }
  
  # Collect data from all groups
  for(group_name in names(groups_with_triplet)) {
    sessions_3 <- groups_with_triplet[[group_name]]
    
    if(length(sessions_3) > 0) {
      for(s in sessions_3) {
        # Get dates in order for this group
        group_dates <- climate_lab %>%
          filter(group == group_name) %>%
          group_by(date) %>%
          slice(1) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          arrange(date) %>%
          mutate(exp_session = row_number())
        
        # Get the date for session s
        target_date <- group_dates %>%
          filter(exp_session == s) %>%
          pull(date)
        
        if(length(target_date) > 0) {
          # Get detailed time series data for this group and date
          g_timeseries <- climate_lab %>%
            filter(group == group_name, date == target_date) %>%
            select(group, date, time_block, top_30min, rh_30min, co2_30min, iaq_30min) %>%
            filter(!is.na(time_block)) %>%
            group_by(time_block) %>%
            slice(1) %>%
            ungroup()
          
          df_triplet_climate <- rbind(df_triplet_climate, g_timeseries)
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  if(nrow(df_triplet_climate) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data found for triplet", triplet_type))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Add block number - take last 10 blocks only
  df_triplet_climate <- df_triplet_climate %>%
    group_by(group, date) %>%
    arrange(desc(time_block)) %>%
    slice(1:10) %>%
    arrange(time_block) %>%
    mutate(block_num = 10:1) %>%
    mutate(block_num = 11 - block_num) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  # Calculate summary based on variable
  if(variable == "top") {
    triplet_summary <- df_triplet_climate %>%
      group_by(block_num) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_val = mean(top_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_val = sd(top_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    y_label <- "Mean Operative Temperature (°C)"
    title_var <- "Operative temperature"
  } else if(variable == "rh") {
    triplet_summary <- df_triplet_climate %>%
      group_by(block_num) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_val = mean(rh_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_val = sd(rh_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    y_label <- "Mean Relative Humidity (%)"
    title_var <- "Relative humidity"
  } else if(variable == "co2") {
    triplet_summary <- df_triplet_climate %>%
      group_by(block_num) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_val = mean(co2_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_val = sd(co2_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    y_label <- "Mean CO₂ Concentration (ppm)"
    title_var <- "CO₂ concentration"
  } else if(variable == "iaq") {
    triplet_summary <- df_triplet_climate %>%
      group_by(block_num) %>%
      summarise(
        mean_val = mean(iaq_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_val = sd(iaq_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = n(),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    y_label <- "Mean IAQ Index"
    title_var <- "Indoor air quality"
  }
  
  # Calculate y-axis limits
  y_min <- floor(min(triplet_summary$mean_val - triplet_summary$sd_val, 
                     na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 - 0.1
  y_max <- ceiling(max(triplet_summary$mean_val + triplet_summary$sd_val, 
                       na.rm = TRUE) * 10) / 10 + 0.1
  
  # Determine intervention color based on third letter
  third_letter <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  intervention_label <- ifelse(third_letter == "D", "dim\n(10 lx)", "bright\n(1000 lx)")
  
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_type, 1, 2)
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_type, 3, 3)
  
  # Count unique group-date combinations
  n_groups <- df_triplet_climate %>%
    select(group, date) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    nrow()
  
  p <- ggplot(triplet_summary, aes(x = block_num, y = mean_val)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("text", x = 3.5, y = y_max - (y_max - y_min) * 0.03, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 8, y = y_max - (y_max - y_min) * 0.03, label = intervention_label, 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, 
             color = ifelse(third_letter == "D", "grey50", "#B8860B"), 
             fontface = "italic") +
    annotate("text", x = 10, y = y_max - (y_max - y_min) * 0.03, label = "dim\n(10 lx)", 
             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 1, size = 3.5, color = "grey50", fontface = "italic") +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_val - sd_val,
                    ymax = mean_val + sd_val),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 3.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = c(
        "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)", 
        "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
      ),
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min, y_max), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = bquote(.(title_var) * " time course - Triplet " * 
                     .(triplet_first_two) * bold(.(triplet_third))),
      subtitle = paste0("Grand average third-day (n=", n_groups, " group sessions)"),
      x = "30-minute block (hours before HBT)",
      y = y_label
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      aspect.ratio = 1,
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, hjust = 0),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 13, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9, margin = margin(t = 5)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 14),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 12)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 8)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(15, 10, 10, 10)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Generate all plots for all triplets and all variables
triplets_all <- c("DDD", "DDB", "DBD", "DBB", "BDD", "BDB", "BBD", "BBB")
variables <- c("top", "rh", "co2", "iaq")

# Example usage - Temperature plots for all triplets
```

### Grand average time-course

```{r}
# Map light conditions to each session for Climate data
# Climate data is at group level, so we map sessions to groups
light_patterns_climate <- list(
  "Group 1" = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  "Group 2" = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  "Group 3" = c("D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B"),
  "Group 4" = c("D", "D", "D", "B", "D", "B", "B", "B", "D", "B", "D", "D")
)

# Create light mapping dataframe for climate
df_light_climate <- bind_rows(lapply(names(light_patterns_climate), function(g) {
  pattern <- light_patterns_climate[[g]]
  data.frame(
    group = g,
    exp_session = seq_along(pattern),
    light = pattern,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

# Get climate data with time blocks
df_climate_timeseries <- climate_lab %>%
  filter(!is.na(time_block)) %>%
  group_by(session_id, date, group, time_block) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup()

# Add session numbers
df_climate_timeseries <- df_climate_timeseries %>%
  group_by(group) %>%
  arrange(date) %>%
  mutate(exp_session = dense_rank(date)) %>%
  ungroup()

# For Group 4, exclude session 5
df_climate_timeseries <- df_climate_timeseries %>%
  filter(!(group == "Group 4" & exp_session == 5))

# Join with light conditions
df_climate_light <- df_climate_timeseries %>%
  inner_join(df_light_climate, by = c("group", "exp_session"))

# Assign block numbers (1-10)
df_climate_light <- df_climate_light %>%
  group_by(group, session_id) %>%
  arrange(time_block) %>%
  mutate(block_num = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Calculate per-group summary for each variable
df_summary_climate_per_group <- df_climate_light %>%
  group_by(group, block_num, light) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_top = mean(top_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_rh = mean(rh_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_co2 = mean(co2_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_iaq = mean(iaq_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(light = factor(light, levels = c("D", "B"), labels = c("Dim", "Bright")))

# Grand average across all groups
grand_summary_climate_manual <- data.frame()

for(b in unique(df_summary_climate_per_group$block_num)) {
  for(l in levels(df_summary_climate_per_group$light)) {
    
    # Get values for this block and light condition
    subset_data <- df_summary_climate_per_group %>%
      filter(block_num == b, light == l)
    
    n_val <- nrow(subset_data)
    
    if(n_val > 0) {
      grand_summary_climate_manual <- rbind(grand_summary_climate_manual, data.frame(
        block_num = b,
        light = l,
        mean_top = mean(subset_data$mean_top, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_top = sd(subset_data$mean_top, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_top = sd(subset_data$mean_top, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_val),
        mean_rh = mean(subset_data$mean_rh, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_rh = sd(subset_data$mean_rh, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_rh = sd(subset_data$mean_rh, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_val),
        mean_co2 = mean(subset_data$mean_co2, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_co2 = sd(subset_data$mean_co2, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_co2 = sd(subset_data$mean_co2, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_val),
        mean_iaq = mean(subset_data$mean_iaq, na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_iaq = sd(subset_data$mean_iaq, na.rm = TRUE),
        se_iaq = sd(subset_data$mean_iaq, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n_val),
        n = n_val
      ))
    }
  }
}

grand_summary_climate_manual$light <- factor(grand_summary_climate_manual$light, 
                                              levels = c("Bright", "Dim"))

# Ensure block_num is numeric
grand_summary_climate_manual <- grand_summary_climate_manual %>%
  mutate(block_num = as.numeric(block_num))

# Define labels
hbt_values <- c("5.25", "4.75", "4.25", "3.75", "3.25", "2.75", "2.25", "1.75", "1.25", "0.75")

# Create x-axis labels
```

### Panel view - triplet and grand average time courses (operative temperature)

```{r}
#| label: fig-top-triplet-panel
#| fig-cap: "Operative temperature time course - Grand average and triplet patterns (group-level data)"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8

# 1. Prepare data 
triplets_all_panel <- c("DDD", "BDD", "DBD", "BBD", "DDB", "BDB", "DBB", "BBB")

df_all_triplets_climate_for_panel <- data.frame()

for(triplet_type in triplets_all_panel) {
  
  # Group 1
  if(triplet_type %in% df_triplets_g1$triplet) {
    sessions_end <- df_triplets_g1 %>%
      filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
      pull(session_end)
    
    for(s in sessions_end) {
      g1_dates <- climate_lab %>%
        filter(group == "Group 1") %>%
        group_by(date) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        ungroup() %>%
        arrange(date) %>%
        mutate(exp_session = row_number())
      
      target_date <- g1_dates %>%
        filter(exp_session == s) %>%
        pull(date)
      
      if(length(target_date) > 0) {
        g_timeseries <- climate_lab %>%
          filter(group == "Group 1", date == target_date) %>%
          select(group, date, time_block, top_30min, rh_30min, co2_30min, iaq_30min) %>%
          filter(!is.na(time_block)) %>%
          group_by(time_block) %>%
          slice(1) %>%
          ungroup() %>%
          arrange(desc(time_block)) %>%
          slice(1:10) %>%
          arrange(time_block) %>%
          mutate(
            triplet = triplet_type,
            exp_session = s,
            block_num = 10:1
          ) %>%
          mutate(block_num = 11 - block_num)
        
        df_all_triplets_climate_for_panel <- rbind(df_all_triplets_climate_for_panel, g_timeseries)
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Group 2
  if(triplet_type %in% df_triplets_g2$triplet) {
    sessions_end <- df_triplets_g2 %>%
      filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%
      pull(session_end)

    }
  }
  
  # Group 3 (uses same sequence as Group 2)
  if(triplet_type %in% df_triplets_g2$triplet) {
    sessions_end <- df_triplets_g2 %>%
      filter(triplet == triplet_type) %>%

    for(s in sessions_end) {

# 2. Calculate summary with SE
triplet_summary_top_for_panel <- df_all_triplets_climate_for_panel %>%
  group_by(triplet, block_num) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_top = mean(top_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_top = sd(top_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_top = sd(top_30min, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(triplet = factor(triplet, levels = triplets_all_panel))

# 3. Unified Y-axis limits
all_mins <- triplet_summary_top_for_panel$mean_top - triplet_summary_top_for_panel$se_top
all_maxs <- triplet_summary_top_for_panel$mean_top + triplet_summary_top_for_panel$se_top
y_min_top_unified <- floor(min(all_mins, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 - 0.5
y_max_top_unified <- ceiling(max(all_maxs, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 + 0.5

grand_mins <- grand_summary_climate_manual$mean_top - grand_summary_climate_manual$se_top
grand_maxs <- grand_summary_climate_manual$mean_top + grand_summary_climate_manual$se_top
y_min_top_unified <- min(y_min_top_unified, floor(min(grand_mins, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 - 0.5)
y_max_top_unified <- max(y_max_top_unified, ceiling(max(grand_maxs, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 + 0.5)

# 4. Function to create triplet plot
create_triplet_plot_top <- function(triplet_name, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE) {
  data_triplet <- triplet_summary_top_for_panel %>%
    filter(triplet == triplet_name)
  
  if(nrow(data_triplet) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data for triplet", triplet_name))
    return(ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = triplet_name))
  }
  
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_name, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_name, 1, 2)
  triplet_label <- paste0(triplet_first_two, "**", triplet_third, "**")
  
  x_labels_with_hbt <- c(
    "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)", 
    "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
  )
  
  ggplot(data_triplet, aes(x = block_num, y = mean_top)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_top - se_top, ymax = mean_top + se_top),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = if(show_x) x_labels_with_hbt else 1:10,
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_top_unified, y_max_top_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = triplet_label,
      x = NULL,
      y = if(show_y) "Mean Temp ± SE (°C)" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_markdown(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = if(show_x) 7 else 8, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 5)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, if(show_x) 8 else 5, 5)
    )
}

# 5. Create all triplet plots
p_DDD_top <- create_triplet_plot_top("DDD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE)
p_BDD_top <- create_triplet_plot_top("BDD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DBD_top <- create_triplet_plot_top("DBD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_BBD_top <- create_triplet_plot_top("BBD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DDB_top <- create_triplet_plot_top("DDB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = TRUE)
p_BDB_top <- create_triplet_plot_top("BDB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DBB_top <- create_triplet_plot_top("DBB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)
p_BBB_top <- create_triplet_plot_top("BBB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)

# 6. Grand Average plot
p_grand_top_panel <- ggplot(grand_summary_climate_manual,
       aes(x = block_num, y = mean_top, color = light, fill = light, group = light)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#FFF9E6", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_top - se_top, ymax = mean_top + se_top),
              alpha = 0.1, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10lx)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10lx)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:10,
    labels = 1:10,
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_top_unified, y_max_top_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Grand Average",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Light condition"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 2.5)),
    fill = "none"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(t = 3)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# 7. Empty spacer
p_spacer_top <- ggplot() + theme_void()

# 8. Combine in layout
(p_DDD_top | p_BDD_top | p_DBD_top | p_BBD_top | p_grand_top_panel) /
(p_DDB_top | p_BDB_top | p_DBB_top | p_BBB_top | p_spacer_top) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Operative temperature time course - Grand average and triplet patterns",
    subtitle = "Grand average and third-day triplet patterns (group-level data)",
    caption = "30-minute block (hours before HBT)",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0, face = "plain"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 10))
    )
  )
```

### Panel view - triplet and grand average time courses (relative humidity)

```{r}
#| label: fig-rh-triplet-panel
#| fig-cap: "Relative humidity time course - Grand average and triplet patterns (group-level data)"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8

# Calculate summary with SE - RELATIVE HUMIDITY
triplet_summary_rh_for_panel <- df_all_triplets_climate_for_panel %>%
  group_by(triplet, block_num) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rh = mean(rh_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_rh = sd(rh_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_rh = sd(rh_30min, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(triplet = factor(triplet, levels = triplets_all_panel))

# Unified Y-axis limits
all_mins_rh <- triplet_summary_rh_for_panel$mean_rh - triplet_summary_rh_for_panel$se_rh
all_maxs_rh <- triplet_summary_rh_for_panel$mean_rh + triplet_summary_rh_for_panel$se_rh
y_min_rh_unified <- floor(min(all_mins_rh, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 - 0.5
y_max_rh_unified <- ceiling(max(all_maxs_rh, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 + 0.5

grand_mins_rh <- grand_summary_climate_manual$mean_rh - grand_summary_climate_manual$se_rh
grand_maxs_rh <- grand_summary_climate_manual$mean_rh + grand_summary_climate_manual$se_rh
y_min_rh_unified <- min(y_min_rh_unified, floor(min(grand_mins_rh, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 - 0.5)
y_max_rh_unified <- max(y_max_rh_unified, ceiling(max(grand_maxs_rh, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 + 0.5)

# Function to create triplet plot - RELATIVE HUMIDITY
create_triplet_plot_rh <- function(triplet_name, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE) {
  data_triplet <- triplet_summary_rh_for_panel %>%
    filter(triplet == triplet_name)
  
  if(nrow(data_triplet) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data for triplet", triplet_name))
    return(ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = triplet_name))
  }
  
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_name, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_name, 1, 2)
  triplet_label <- paste0(triplet_first_two, "**", triplet_third, "**")
  
  x_labels_with_hbt <- c(
    "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)", 
    "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
  )
  
  ggplot(data_triplet, aes(x = block_num, y = mean_rh)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_rh - se_rh, ymax = mean_rh + se_rh),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = if(show_x) x_labels_with_hbt else 1:10,
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_rh_unified, y_max_rh_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = triplet_label,
      x = NULL,
      y = if(show_y) "Mean RH ± SE (%)" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_markdown(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = if(show_x) 7 else 8, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 5)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, if(show_x) 8 else 5, 5)
    )
}

# Create all triplet plots - RELATIVE HUMIDITY

p_BDD_rh <- create_triplet_plot_rh("BDD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DBD_rh <- create_triplet_plot_rh("DBD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
```

### Panel view - triplet and grand average time courses (air quality index)

```{r}
#| label: fig-iaq-triplet-panel
#| fig-cap: "Indoor air quality time course - Grand average and triplet patterns (group-level data)"
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 8

# Calculate summary with SE - IAQ
triplet_summary_iaq_for_panel <- df_all_triplets_climate_for_panel %>%
  group_by(triplet, block_num) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_iaq = mean(iaq_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_iaq = sd(iaq_30min, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se_iaq = sd(iaq_30min, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(triplet = factor(triplet, levels = triplets_all_panel))

# Unified Y-axis limits
all_mins_iaq <- triplet_summary_iaq_for_panel$mean_iaq - triplet_summary_iaq_for_panel$se_iaq
all_maxs_iaq <- triplet_summary_iaq_for_panel$mean_iaq + triplet_summary_iaq_for_panel$se_iaq
y_min_iaq_unified <- floor(min(all_mins_iaq, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 - 0.5
y_max_iaq_unified <- ceiling(max(all_maxs_iaq, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 + 0.5

grand_mins_iaq <- grand_summary_climate_manual$mean_iaq - grand_summary_climate_manual$se_iaq
grand_maxs_iaq <- grand_summary_climate_manual$mean_iaq + grand_summary_climate_manual$se_iaq
y_min_iaq_unified <- min(y_min_iaq_unified, floor(min(grand_mins_iaq, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 - 0.5)
y_max_iaq_unified <- max(y_max_iaq_unified, ceiling(max(grand_maxs_iaq, na.rm = TRUE) * 2) / 2 + 0.5)

# Function to create triplet plot - IAQ
create_triplet_plot_iaq <- function(triplet_name, show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE) {
  data_triplet <- triplet_summary_iaq_for_panel %>%
    filter(triplet == triplet_name)
  
  if(nrow(data_triplet) == 0) {
    warning(paste("No data for triplet", triplet_name))
    return(ggplot() + theme_void() + labs(title = triplet_name))
  }
  
  triplet_third <- substr(triplet_name, 3, 3)
  intervention_color <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", "#F5F5F5", "#FFF9E6")
  intervention_alpha <- ifelse(triplet_third == "D", 0.4, 0.8)
  
  triplet_first_two <- substr(triplet_name, 1, 2)
  triplet_label <- paste0(triplet_first_two, "**", triplet_third, "**")
  
  x_labels_with_hbt <- c(
    "B1\n(5.25h)", "B2", "B3\n(4.25h)", "B4", "B5\n(3.25h)", 
    "B6", "B7\n(2.25h)", "B8", "B9\n(1.25h)", "B10"
  )
  
  ggplot(data_triplet, aes(x = block_num, y = mean_iaq)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = intervention_color, alpha = intervention_alpha) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_iaq - se_iaq, ymax = mean_iaq + se_iaq),
                alpha = 0.15, fill = "grey40") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 16, color = "black") +
    scale_x_continuous(
      breaks = 1:10,
      labels = if(show_x) x_labels_with_hbt else 1:10,
      limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
      expand = c(0, 0)
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_iaq_unified, y_max_iaq_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    labs(
      title = triplet_label,
      x = NULL,
      y = if(show_y) "Mean IAQ ± SE" else NULL
    ) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_markdown(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = if(show_x) 7 else 8, margin = margin(t = 3)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 5)),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
      plot.margin = margin(5, 5, if(show_x) 8 else 5, 5)
    )
}

# Create all triplet plots - IAQ
p_DDD_iaq <- create_triplet_plot_iaq("DDD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = TRUE)
p_BDD_iaq <- create_triplet_plot_iaq("BDD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DBD_iaq <- create_triplet_plot_iaq("DBD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_BBD_iaq <- create_triplet_plot_iaq("BBD", show_x = FALSE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DDB_iaq <- create_triplet_plot_iaq("DDB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = TRUE)
p_BDB_iaq <- create_triplet_plot_iaq("BDB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)
p_DBB_iaq <- create_triplet_plot_iaq("DBB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)
p_BBB_iaq <- create_triplet_plot_iaq("BBB", show_x = TRUE, show_y = FALSE)

# Grand Average plot - IAQ
p_grand_iaq_panel <- ggplot(grand_summary_climate_manual,
       aes(x = block_num, y = mean_iaq, color = light, fill = light, group = light)) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 0.5, xmax = 6.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 9.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#F5F5F5", alpha = 0.4) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 6.5, xmax = 9.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#FFF9E6", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_iaq - se_iaq, ymax = mean_iaq + se_iaq),
              alpha = 0.1, color = NA, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5, shape = 16) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10lx)")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Bright" = "#F5A623", "Dim" = "#4A90E2"),
    labels = c("Bright" = "Bright (1000lx)", "Dim" = "Dim (10lx)")
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:10,
    labels = 1:10,
    limits = c(0.5, 10.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(y_min_iaq_unified, y_max_iaq_unified), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(
    title = "Grand Average",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    color = "Light condition"
  ) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 16, size = 2.5)),
    fill = "none"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 5)),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 9),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, margin = margin(t = 3)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 7),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )

# Empty spacer
p_spacer_iaq <- ggplot() + theme_void()

# Combine all plots - IAQ
(p_DDD_iaq | p_BDD_iaq | p_DBD_iaq | p_BBD_iaq | p_grand_iaq_panel) /
(p_DDB_iaq | p_BDB_iaq | p_DBB_iaq | p_BBB_iaq | p_spacer_iaq) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Indoor air quality time course - Grand average and triplet patterns",
    subtitle = "Grand average and third-day triplet patterns (group-level data)",
    caption = "30-minute block (hours before HBT)",
    theme = theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = 0, face = "plain"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0, margin = margin(b = 8)),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(t = 10))
    )
  )
```
